channel.question: Which customer channel can I connect?
channel.answer: EasyModerator connects Facebook Pages for Messenger conversations. Other customer channels are not presented as connected here.

ai.question: Does an AI draft get sent automatically?
ai.answer: No. A Draft is saved for review and is not sent. Manual, Draft and Auto modes are available where enabled; sending and order decisions follow shop permissions and applicable messaging rules.

quota.question: How is a conversation counted?
quota.answer: Messages in the same Messenger thread for the same shop, customer and Page count as one conversation while the thread stays active. A new conversation starts after 24 hours with no activity in that thread.

signup.question: What happens when I create an account?
signup.answer: A new account starts on Shuru. Choosing Growth from this page does not purchase or activate Growth; Partner applications are reviewed separately.

pricing.title: Plans for your connected workflow
pricing.subtitle: Compare published plan prices, Messenger conversation allowances and Partner terms. New accounts start on Shuru.
pricing.catalogUnavailable: Current plan details are unavailable right now. Try again to load the published catalog.
pricing.partnerNoMonthlyFee: No monthly subscription fee; billed by delivered order after approval.
pricing.conversationCountNote: We count one active Messenger thread for the same shop, customer, channel and Page. Messages in that thread count once until 24 hours pass with no thread activity.
pricing.newAccountsNote: New accounts start on Shuru. You can review Growth after signup; registration does not activate a paid plan.
pricing.growthMonthlyNote: Growth is shown monthly. New annual selections are not available.
pricing.coreFeatureParity: All three plans include the same core customer-support and commerce tools. They differ in conversation allowance, Partner billing and qualification.
pricing.topupsCaveat: Eligible Growth accounts only. Each pack is a separate one-time purchase, not part of the monthly plan fee. When bKash checkout is enabled, successful payment adds conversations to the balance. Unused balance carries into the next billing period. AI replies pause only after both the included allowance and top-up balance run out; manual replies remain available.
pricing.partnerQualification: Partner applications require review. Qualification is based on at least 300 delivered orders in the rolling 30-day window.
pricing.partnerBillingNote: For each Partner invoice period, 0–299 delivered orders have no per-order fee. At 300 or more, the matching rate applies to every delivered order in that period. Period dates follow your account invoice, not calendar months. Application eligibility uses a separate rolling 30-day window.
pricing.partnerThresholdExample: At {{belowThresholdOrders}} delivered orders: ৳0 per-order fees. At {{orders}}: {{orders}} × ৳{{rate}} = ৳{{total}} for the invoice period.
pricing.partnerReviewNote: Submitting an application requests review; it does not activate Partner billing.
pricing.catalogUnitNote: Conversation allowances follow the billing period on the account. A conversation is not counted per message or per AI reply.
pricing.separateBoundary: These plans cover EasyModerator's core customer-support and commerce tools. A plan includes only the tools listed in its details. If a capability is offered separately, it has separate pricing and access terms.
pricing.applicationDescription: Share your business details for review. This form sends an application and does not change your plan.
